Action: supply $25 into the Valantis stHYPE Restaking contract from an official page, budgeting ~30 minutes and gas of $1-$5 per chain.
Weekly: keep the position untouched and record a weekly qualifying action; each interaction costs ~$2 gas and ~10 minutes on Hyperliquid L1.
Window: hold for 3 months to satisfy airdrop snapshots; early exits forfeit the farming point and the $25 earns no bonus.
Safety: confirm the claim link on the project's official docs page, never a DM; a phishing link costs your whole $25.
Log: maintain a dated farm log with tx hashes; expect a total time budget of 4-8 hours over the 3 months.
